defs: def plug: .manifest.plugins[0]; def schema: plug.input_schema; def tool: .assets["plugins/d3_decision/TOOL.md"]; def readme: .assets["README.md"]; def origins: ["http://100.74.68.88:8000", "http://100.86.62.91:8100"];

jq.name: the pack ships exactly the d3_decision plugin, in rust, and no documents
the only authority is host-served HTTP to the two D3 origins
jq.expr: plug.manifold == {"child_process": false, "crypto": false, "env": "None", "fs": "None", "http_timeout_ms": 10000, "net": {"OutboundHttp": origins}} and (plug | has("bind_dir") | not) and (plug | has("model_slot") | not)

jq.name: limits stay inside the host ceilings and leave room past the HTTP timeout
jq.expr: plug.limits.memory_mib <= 4096 and plug.limits.max_output_mib <= 4 and plug.limits.wall_clock_secs * 1000 > plug.manifold.http_timeout_ms * 2

jq.name: the schema is closed, requires context and questions, and names servers, never URLs
jq.expr: schema.additionalProperties == false and schema.required == ["context", "questions"] and schema.properties.server.enum == ["spark-1", "spark-2"] and schema.properties.server.default == "spark-1" and (schema.properties | keys) == ["context", "questions", "server"]

jq.name: questions are the three typed kinds, 1 to 16 of them
every field and question kind the schema names is explained in the tool instructions
jq.expr: tool as $t | [(schema.properties | keys[]), "type", "instructions", "criteria", "noul", "choice", "score", "retryable"] | all(. as $k | $t | contains("`" + $k + "`"))

jq.name: the tool instructions and README name both origins, the timeout and the no-retry rule
jq.expr: tool as $t | readme as $r | all(origins[]; . as $o | ($t | contains($o)) and ($r | contains($o))) and ($t | contains("10 seconds")) and ($t | contains("Nothing is retried")) and ($r | contains("bearer"))

jq.name: the tool instructions carry a wake-gate example that is a valid input
jq.expr: tool | contains("## Example: a wake gate") and ([scan("```json\n([\\s\\S]*?)\n```") | .[0] | fromjson] as $ex | ($ex | length) == 1 and ($ex[0] | (keys == ["context", "questions"]) and .questions.wake.type == "noul" and .questions.reason.type == "choice"))
